title: Todd Monken not ready to name QB1, Shedeur Sanders, Deshaun Watson to continue competition

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Coach says Browns QB1 competition to continue
sources.description: Browns coach Todd Monken said he is unlikely to name a starting quarterback between Deshaun Watson and Shedeur Sanders at the conclusion of mandatory minicamp on Thursday.

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Todd Monken not ready to name QB1, Shedeur Sanders, Deshaun Watson to continue competition
sources.description: Browns head coach Todd Monken has said that he would prefer to have a starting quarterback named by the end of the offseason program.
